svg.title: Control plane identities and their writes
svg.desc: Identities of ADR-0038, proposed and not built. In each spoke, the analyzer, executor and verifier keep the writes that invariant 6 gives them today. The new spoke identity shadewright-reporter reads Incidents, RemediationRequests and VerificationReports in the operator namespace, plus get on remediationsettings, get on the kube-system Namespace by resource name and get on the non-resource URL /openid/v1/jwks. It also reads, by resource name, the one ConfigMap shadewright-cluster-registration. Its only write, proposed, is update on that ConfigMap, which holds the ready Cluster manifest and the last result from the hub and which the chart creates only when absent and never overwrites. The reporter has no Secrets, no Git identity and no model credential, and its network egress is limited to port 443 by a NetworkPolicy, with the hub's host pinned in its code and settings, because a NetworkPolicy cannot match host names. It sends reports to the hub's intake service. At the hub, intake may write the reported record kinds and its key observations, which record keys a spoke reported that the hub does not trust yet, using one static ClusterRole from the chart bound in each spoke namespace. RBAC does not keep it to one namespace: that guard is intake's code, which takes the namespace from the verified Cluster object, and it needs tests. Intake has no write on Cluster objects, no Git write and no model credential, and it fetches issuer discovery documents only from allow-listed hosts. The fleet controller alone writes Cluster status, including the trusted and pending keys, promoting and dropping them from intake's observations. Otherwise it creates Namespaces, ResourceQuotas and RoleBindings only, and patches and deletes the Namespaces it created when a spoke is revoked, with bind limited to that one ClusterRole and no escalate, never Roles, and a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy limits it to namespaces with the spoke prefix that it created, with intake's ServiceAccount as the only RoleBinding subject, and holds no spoke credential or kubeconfig. The status page can only read. People who may merge in the hub GitOps repository approve each new spoke. No hub identity is cluster-admin, and none has a model credential or a Git write identity in phase 1.
svg.text: namespace from the verified Cluster: code guard
never: Cluster objects, Git, model credential
egress: issuer hosts on the allow-list
People who merge in the hub repo
report over HTTPS: the only line from spoke to hub
One static ClusterRole for intake; no hub identity is cluster-admin.
No hub component has a model credential or a Git write identity in phase 1.
Each spoke has its own model credential (key: ADR-0037) and daily budget (ADR-0023).
